subject: Assurance scope handoff and pen-test guardrails
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@greenway-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Michelle Park <m.park@greenway-analytics.com>, Greenway Analytics Legal <legal@greenway-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the draft MSA & order form. Our legal team flagged a few items in the assurance exhibit we need to clarify before procurement can move forward:

- SOC 2: your current exhibit references "latest SOC 2 Type II report upon request." We need to confirm cadence (annual) and that you can provide a summary of scope (systems in-scope).
- Pen test: request for clarity on whether we can require on-site/remote access or expect a summary report only. We prefer the ability to request limited penetration testing evidence in support of our vendor risk assessments.
- Audit rights: our security team would like an explicit window for evidence delivery and a runbook for what counts as "reasonable" access.
- Evidence delivery: prefer a secure portal or SFTP for SOC2 and pen-test summaries; can you confirm approach and retention period for logs (30/90/365 days)?

Can your team propose narrow, playbook-style language we can include in the Order Form that limits disruption but satisfies our auditors? If you can send suggested wording and a short timeline for when Redwood's legal can provide a redline, that would help.

Also attaching the list of evidence items the buyer typically requests (I will follow up with our procurement lead).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Tom Reynolds
Head of IT Risk | Greenway Analytics
[t.reynolds@greenway-analytics.com]
[Attachment: greenway_evidence_list.xlsx]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Laura / Monica — forwarding Tom's note from Greenway. Key asks: SOC2 scope/cadence confirmation, pen-test access language, evidence delivery window and retention.

Proposed quick approach:
- Legal (Laura) drafts narrow exhibit language that: confirms annual SOC2 Type II availability, provides a high-level in-scope systems list, allows provision of SOC2 report under NDA/portal access rather than full public posting.
- Pen-test: offer vendor summary + remediation validation; agree to provide more detailed artifacts to the customer's security team under a scoped NDA / scheduled 2-business-day evidence window during an agreed maintenance window.
- Audit rights: limit to no more than one on-site/interactive audit per 12 months, otherwise provide evidence package via our secure portal.

I've attached a lightweight draft of the security exhibit with suggested guardrails — this is intentionally prescriptive to shorten redline cycles.

Next steps: Laura, can you take the draft and produce a legal redline plus a fallback compromise we can share with Greenway? Monica, please confirm operational feasibility for the portal / evidence retention (30/90/365) and the pen-test access window.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft_security_exhibit_v1.md]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Soojin / Monica —

Appreciate the summary. I've reviewed Tom's asks and the attached draft. Below are legal-level suggestions before we send back to Greenway:

1) SOC 2
- Confirm: Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II report annually for the most recent 12-month period covering the production inference platform ("in-scope systems"). We will provide a redacted copy via secure portal upon execution of a confidentiality agreement.
- Compromise language: "Customer may request the most recent SOC 2 Type II report once per 12-month period; Redwood will make a redacted copy available via secure portal within 15 business days of request."

2) Penetration Testing / Vulnerability Evidence
- We will provide a vendor-validated penetration test summary and a remediation attestation. Redwood prefers to limit direct interactive testing or live access requests.
- If Customer requests additional evidence beyond the summary, Customer must: (a) submit a written request with scope, (b) execute a separate non-disclosure agreement and mutually agree on a time window. Limit to one such request per 12 months.

3) Audit Rights / Evidence Delivery
- Propose a playbook: Redwood will provide an evidence package (SOC 2 summary, pen-test summary, selected logs, and remediation records) within 15 business days of request. For any on-site or interactive audit, provide 30 days' advance notice; Redwood may require mutually agreeable timing that does not unreasonably disrupt operations.

4) Retention
- Logs: Redwood retains inference platform access/audit logs for 90 days by default; extension options available via dedicated contract add-on.

I will produce a redline of the MSA with the exhibit changes and a short "fallback" paragraph if Greenway insists on broader rights. Attaching the redline now.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redline_MSA_v3.docx]

From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@greenway-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Michelle Park <m.park@greenway-analytics.com>, Greenway Analytics Legal <legal@greenway-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Laura / Soojin —

Thanks for the quick response and concrete proposals. A couple of clarifying questions:

- The 15-business-day window for SOC2 — will Greenway need to execute a separate NDA for every request or will the standard MSA confidentiality suffice for portal access?
- For pen-test evidence, can you provide a short example snippet of the "pen-test summary + remediation attestation" wording so we can share with our audit team?
- Can you confirm log retention is 90 days by default and whether we can purchase a 365-day retention add-on?

If you can paste the suggested pen-test paragraph into email (or the redline) that would be ideal. We'll try to avoid a heavy back-and-forth — if needed, we can set a 30-minute working session tomorrow to run through the redline.

Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of IT Risk | Greenway Analytics

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@greenway-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Tom —

Below is a short, negotiable paragraph we can put in the Security Exhibit to address the pen-test evidence ask. Feel free to share with your auditors; Laura will follow up with a formal redline that includes this language.

"Penetration testing and vulnerability evidence: Redwood performs an annual third-party penetration test of its production inference platform and maintains remediation records for identified issues. Redwood will provide Customer a pen-test summary and a remediation attestation via Redwood's secure portal. Upon written request and subject to a mutually executed confidentiality agreement, Redwood will make available additional supporting artifacts for review in a controlled environment. Customer shall limit such requests to one occurrence per 12-month period unless otherwise agreed in writing. Redwood will respond to a request for additional artifacts within 15 business days and will reasonably coordinate timing to avoid disruption to production services."

Quick answers to your bullets:
- NDA: standard MSA confidentiality clause will govern portal access; for additional artifacts in a controlled review we ask for a brief scoped NDA.
- Logs: default retention 90 days; 365-day retention available as a paid add-on in the Order Form.
- SOC2: we'll provide a redacted copy once per 12-month period via the portal (15 business days).

I'll propose a 30-minute working session tomorrow at 10:00am PT if that works for your team. If you prefer, Laura can send the redline first.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@greenway-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Michelle Park <m.park@greenway-analytics.com>, Greenway Analytics Legal <legal@greenway-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Questions on the MSA + assurance exhibit (SOC2 / pen test)

Soojin / Laura —

Thanks for the language — that's helpful and should clear 90% of the items on our side. We'll accept the portal + scoped NDA approach. 10:00am PT tomorrow works for a short call (I've sent a calendar invite).

Two small asks before the session: 
1) Please upload the redline (redline_MSA_v3.docx) to the shared drive link you mentioned so our legal can review ahead of the call.
2) If possible, attach (or summarize) the most recent pen-test summary (redacted) or SOC2 summary so our audit team has context.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom Reynolds
Head of IT Risk | Greenway Analytics
[Attachment: meeting-invite.ics]
